# CSPICE N0067 source

This directory contains the CSPICE N0067 public headers and `src/cspice`
source directory from the NAIF macOS ARM64 distribution. The C source is used
by the repository's platform build scripts; no prebuilt CSPICE library is
committed.

The source and headers are provided by NASA's Navigation and Ancillary
Information Facility. They are not covered by the Threebody Toolbox MIT
License. See the bundled files in `docs` and the repository's
`THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md`.
